brief.summary: Equity futures fell, led by Nasdaq, as AI safety calls stoked slowdown fears. Front-end and long-end yields rose, with 10-year near 5% and 2-year at multi-year highs; markets price a 90% chance of a Fed hike Wednesday. Oil surged as Saudi's East-West pipeline shut and geopolitics escalated. Credit spreads were little changed; the dollar was not clearly discussed. Consumer data remained mixed-to-resilient, but tech and AI capex uncertainty dominated. Overall tone was risk-off.
